title: appium allows unauthenticated arbitrary file/directory deletion in @appium/storage-plugin (CVE-2026-58192)
description: The Appium storage plugin contains a vulnerability in its HTTP endpoint POST /storage/delete that allows unauthenticated remote clients to delete arbitrary files and directories on the host filesystem. This is due to lack of path sanitization on the user-supplied 'name' parameter, enabling directory traversal attacks. An attacker can recursively delete any file or directory writable by the Appium process user, potentially causing data loss and denial of service. The issue affects versions prior to 1.1.6 and is fixed in version 1.1.6.
